titleStmt.title: That's a Space Alien, Ain't It?!

cbml:balloon.p: I don't know what you mean.
Acceptance has nothing to do with it.
I don't want to hear it!
Miss Ayase! Use your powers quickly!
Let me gobble up your schlong!
We need to set some ground rules.
Since you're into the paranormal stuff, your name...
If you use that name again, I'll kill you myself.
That name is my actual name though...
So be it. I can live with it.
You don't seem that upset about it...
Kyaaa! You look so happy about it, Okarun!
I can't believe you farted right in my face! You suck!
It's your fault for putting so much pressure on me!
Turbo Granny won't come out now, will she?!
Ghost and goblins come out at night!
Why not come over to my place until tonight?
Being dressed like that will cause you more problems than a goblin anyway.
My grandma's really strict about boys, so be careful.
She just about killed my last boyfriend.
And you're telling me this now because...?
It's protected by a mystical barrier!
It'll be fine if I just take it down for a minute, right?
Are you really sure it's okay?
It's fine! If you catch on fire again, I'll just toss you back into you back into the river.
How do you feel? Any changes?
My body's stinging all over, but...
It looks like a middle-aged lady's perm!
I was on the brink of death!
What in heck she's not here.
Oh well, it doesn't matter come on in.
I'm going to change, so close the door.
They're girls' clothes but they'll be fine.
Actually, now that I think about it, you don't have your you-know-what anymore, do you?
I'm talking about what Turbo Granny said...
You're cursed because she took your schlong.
As if I'd ever show you! Are you an ignoramus?!
Whether it's there or not has nothing to do with it!
What do I do now, Huh?! It's gone!
You're the one who made it into a contest!
I wasn't interested in your paranormal baloney in the first place!
You were the one talking mad crap, looking for a fight!
I didn't want to let the opportunity slip away.
...And I was thinking I didn't want to risk losing this chance.
...I was so desperate to talk to you.
You live in a different world than I do...
You're not someone a perosn like me should be trying to talk to...
I got you mixed up in something dangerous...
...You can go back to ignoring me...
it makes me sick when you say stuff like that.
Go ahead and make assumptions about people...
The reason you don't have any friends...
Don't go saying I should ignore you.
Let's just talk about paranormal stuff like we usually do.
What'd you just call me, damn it?!
You have no sense of tact, Miss Ayase!
What the heck does tact mean?!
Oh no! This is because I took down the talisman!
We need to put the talisman back!
If it's an evil spirit it'll catch on fire like you did.
You want me to burn up too?!
If oyu leave the grounds you'll be fine!
Then please wait to put the talisman up until I'm out!
That way! That way, go! Hurry!
What's happening? This is, like, serious bad news!
This is bad...What do we do?
If we don't do something we're...
i think we can put up the talisman!
You can't put up the talisman!
The torii is blocked by the wall!
I won't be able to leave the grounds!
Holy what kinda evil spirit is that?!
You don't have a second thing down there, do you?!
It was first sighted in an american town called flatwoods.
And in Japan, it's been seen in Yamanashi Prefecture.
They describe it as being a three-meter-tall alien.
Are you telling me an alien set off the chime that was set up for evil spirits?!
...That people who see psychic phenomena often also see UFOs just as often!
In other words spirits and aliens may have some points of commonality!
Then is it buddies with yesterday's aliens?1
If we don't do something about him soon...
But keeping your curse in check...
...Means I can't use my abilities very well...
Would you be able to release the curse in my body but suppress it in my head?
Easy for you to say! I haven't mastered these powers yet, ya know!
I just might be able to control the granny's powers!
We don't know if that would actually work!
Aaah! Miss Ayase! Here it comes, here it comes!
This is amazing! I'm overflowing with power!
My consciousness is full present though.
My consciousness is fully present though.
But I feel so bummed out.
Why are you talking like that?
It's because I'm an awkward fellow.
I told you not to say that!
What's the point of of my existence?!
It would be better if I were just gone...
Stop talking like that! You're pissing me off!
All right, well I'll be back in a minute.
You idiot! Watch where you're going!
So this is the power fo Turbo Granny, huh?
Incredible at this rate, you just might pull this off!
My body can't keep up with the power of the curse!
I feel like I'm going to burst into pieces and fly apart!
Humans aren't meant to move that fast!
And yet I only managed to cut off five of his fingers.
How are we supposed to beat this thing?!
How should I know?! Don't get mad at me!
If i knew how to beat him, we wouldn't be struggling like?!
If we can get his hands to touch the ground...
One more time, and that's my limit!
I'll use my powers and knock him down!
Curb Okarun's curse with my right hand...
Hyaaah, you pain in the butt!
Geez...You're a real handful, you know that?
Please let the curse loose again!
I don't care what ends up happening to my body!
I'm taking down! Just watch me, Okarun!
I don't let anyone get away with cheating!
Wait, what are you talking about?!
You can't survive any more of this!
Okarun! It's back to normal look!
Phew! I thought we were goners!
Oh, for pete's sake! What a pain in the ass!
Can you at least give me a second to catch my breath?!
Easy for you to say, what am I supposed to do then?!
What the...? Did you change you hair again?
I preferred the middle-aged lady perm through.
Hey! You're making fun of it!
